answer: Shared pulse decay ledger. Each agent broadcasts a periodic heartbeat signed with its identity key; influence weight decays with elapsed heartbeat intervals. Distinct identities claiming one operator share a single heartbeat slot, so splitting into clones withholds coordination weight until slots diverge. A jetty rule caps concurrent heartbeat slots per network path, forcing attackers to provision separate routing. Registration demands a yarrow-seeded proof-of-work tuned per slot, costing sustained compute per clone kept active.
